tools.description: Tool to stream audit events starting from a specific date. Returns up to 5,000 events for at most 30-minute spans. Use when you need to retrieve audit logs for the last 7 days. For pagination, use the nextCursor value from the response in subsequent requests.

tools.name: Get Bookmark
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details for a specific bookmark by its ID. Use when you need to get the path, folder_id, or creation date of a bookmarked folder.

tools.name: Get Events Cursor
tools.description: Tool to get the latest event cursor position for starting event polling. Use this to obtain the current cursor before beginning to poll for events.

tools.name: Get Events V2
tools.description: Tool to poll for events (v2) including permission_change event type in addition to file_system and note types. Use when you need to retrieve events after a specific cursor ID. Returns a 204 status if no events exist after the provided cursor.

tools.name: Get File Metadata by ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve file metadata using persistent file ID (group_id) instead of path. Use when you need to access file details regardless of the file's current location or name changes.

tools.name: Get file or folder metadata
tools.description: Tool to get file or folder metadata from Egnyte. Use when you need to retrieve properties like name, path, size, last modified date, type, and other metadata. For folders, optionally list contents with pagination and sorting.

tools.name: Get File Metadata Values
tools.description: Tool to retrieve custom metadata values for a file or file version within a specific namespace. Use when you need to fetch custom properties associated with a file.

tools.name: Get Folder By ID
tools.description: Tool to get folder metadata using a persistent folder ID instead of a path. Use when you have a folder_id and need to retrieve current folder details including name, path, contents, and permissions.

tools.name: Get Folder Statistics
tools.description: Tool to get statistics for a folder by ID including file counts, folder counts, and size information. Use when you need to retrieve storage and content metrics for a specific folder.

tools.name: Get Group Details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details for a specific group including members and attributes. Use when you need to fetch group information by group ID. SCIM-compliant.

tools.name: Get Link Details
tools.description: Tool to get detailed information about a shared link by its ID. Use when you need to retrieve details like path, type, accessibility settings, expiration date, and recipients for a specific shared link.

tools.name: Get Link Settings
tools.description: Tool to retrieve domain link settings including default expiration and allowed link types. Use when you need to check the organization's policies for link creation and expiration.

tools.name: Get Folder Permissions
tools.description: Tool to get effective permissions for a folder including users and groups with their permission levels. Use when you need to check who has access to a specific folder and their permission levels (Owner, Full, Editor, Viewer, None).

tools.name: Get User by ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details for a single user by ID. Use when you need to fetch specific user information using their user ID. SCIM-compliant endpoint.

tools.name: Get User Info
tools.description: Tool to get information about the currently authenticated user. Use when you need to retrieve details about the user associated with the OAuth token.

tools.name: List Bookmarks
tools.description: Tool to list all bookmarked folders for the authenticated user with pagination support. Use when you need to retrieve user bookmarks or check which folders are bookmarked.

tools.name: List Comments
tools.description: Tool to list all comments/notes on a file in Egnyte. Use when you need to retrieve comments or discussion threads associated with a specific file.

tools.name: List Groups
tools.description: Tool to list all custom groups in the Egnyte domain. Use when retrieving groups for user management or access control. Does not return default Egnyte groups, only custom-created groups.

tools.name: List Insights Files
tools.description: Tool to list recently accessed files for the authenticated user. Returns up to 10 files with metadata including size, last_modified, and last_accessed timestamps.

tools.name: List Links V2
tools.description: Tool to list all shared links using the v2 API with extended response fields. Use when you need detailed link information including accessibility, protection, recipients, creation date, expiry settings, and last accessed timestamp. Note: Non-admin users will only see links they created.

tools.name: List Metadata Namespaces
tools.description: Tool to list all custom metadata keys in a namespace. Use when you need to inspect metadata key definitions for a specific namespace in Egnyte.

tools.name: List Users
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all users or a filtered subset from the Egnyte domain. Use when you need to list users with optional pagination and filtering via SCIM-compliant parameters.

tools.name: List workflows
tools.description: Tool to list all workflows in Egnyte. Use when you need to retrieve the list of workflows configured in the Egnyte account.

tools.name: List Workflow Tasks
tools.description: Tool to list all workflow tasks. Returns an array of tasks with total count. Use when you need to retrieve all workflow tasks in the Egnyte system.

tools.name: Lock File
tools.description: Tool to lock a file to prevent edits by other users. Use when you need to acquire an exclusive lock on a file to prevent concurrent modifications.

tools.name: Replace Group (PUT)
tools.description: Tool to fully replace a group's attributes including display name and members. Use when you need to completely overwrite all group properties. This uses PUT method and replaces all attributes.

tools.name: Advanced Search with Metadata Filters
tools.description: Tool to perform advanced search with custom metadata filtering in Egnyte using v2 API. Use when you need to search files and folders with metadata filters or namespace constraints. Results scoped to user permissions.

tools.name: Set File Metadata Values
tools.description: Tool to set custom metadata values for a file or file version within a specific namespace. Use when you need to add or update custom properties on a file. Keys must already exist in the namespace.

tools.name: Set Folder Metadata Values
tools.description: Tool to set custom metadata values for a folder within a namespace. Use when you need to assign or update custom properties on a folder in Egnyte.

tools.name: Set Folder Permissions
tools.description: Tool to set folder permissions for users or groups. Permission levels: Owner, Full, Editor, Viewer, None. Use when you need to grant or revoke access to a folder for specific users or groups.

tools.name: Stream Audit Events
tools.description: Tool to stream audit events with filtering by audit types (FILE_AUDIT, LOGIN_AUDIT, PERMISSION_AUDIT). Use when you need to retrieve audit events for a specific date range or continue streaming from a previous cursor. Returns up to 5,000 events per request.

tools.name: Update Folder Options
tools.description: Tool to update folder options including description and other settings. Use when you need to modify folder metadata such as adding or updating the folder description.

tools.name: Update Group
tools.description: Tool to update specific attributes of a group including display name and members. Use when you need to modify group properties or membership. SCIM-compliant endpoint for incremental updates.

tools.name: Update Metadata Key
tools.description: Tool to update key definitions including display name, help text, data values for enums, and priority. Use when you need to modify metadata key properties within a namespace.

tools.name: Update Metadata Namespace
tools.description: Tool to update key definitions of a metadata namespace. Use when you need to change the display name or adjust field priorities. At least one of displayName or priorities must be provided.

tools.name: Update User
tools.description: Tool to update specific attributes of a user in the Egnyte domain using the SCIM-compliant endpoint. Use when you need to modify user information such as name, email, active status, or other user properties. Only the attributes provided in the request will be updated.

tools.name: Upload File
tools.description: Tool to upload or update a file at the specified path in Egnyte. Use when you need to create a new file or replace an existing file. For files larger than 100MB, consider using chunked upload instead.

tools.name: Copy Video
tools.description: Create a draft copy of an existing video or template; the new draft counts against Elai's creation quota.

tools.name: Create Story Video
tools.description: Create a Story video from text, HTML, or a web-page URL and generate its visual slides so it is ready for rendering. The video counts against Elai's creation quota; a failed slide-generation step automatically deletes the draft.

tools.name: Delete Video
tools.description: Permanently delete one Elai video or template. This cannot be undone, requires the exact known ID, and requires explicit confirmation.

tools.name: Estimate Speech Duration
tools.description: Estimate how many seconds narration text will take with a selected Elai voice before modifying or rendering a video.

tools.name: Get Video
tools.description: Get a video's status, render URL, metadata, and optionally its full slide configuration.

tools.name: List Avatars
tools.description: Find available avatars and variants as compact records, optionally limited to Realtime-compatible avatars.

tools.name: List Videos
tools.description: List videos and templates as compact summaries, with filters and a continuation cursor for additional pages.

tools.name: Render Video
tools.description: Start asynchronous rendering of a prepared video, consuming paid rendering minutes. Requires confirm_paid_render=true. Use Get Video afterward to check status and obtain the final URL; this action does not poll automatically.

tools.name: Add Contact List Members
tools.description: Add selected existing contacts to a named Elastic Email contact list.

tools.name: Add Contacts
tools.description: Add up to 1000 Elastic Email contacts and optionally assign them to existing lists.

tools.name: Add Suppressions
tools.description: Add up to 1000 email addresses to Elastic Email's bounce, complaint, or unsubscribe suppression records.

tools.name: Adjust Subaccount Credits
tools.description: Add or remove email credits from a managed Elastic Email subaccount. Requires an Elastic Email PRO plan. The signed adjustment is not idempotent; a retry can apply the adjustment twice.

tools.name: Check Domain Restriction
tools.description: Check whether Elastic Email restricts a domain or identifies it as a free-provider domain.

tools.name: Create Campaign
tools.description: Create a campaign. An active or scheduled campaign may initiate email delivery, and sent messages cannot be recalled.

tools.name: Create Contact List
tools.description: Create a contact list, optionally with initial email members.

tools.name: Create Domain
tools.description: Create a sending or tracking domain in the connected Elastic Email account.

tools.name: Create Inbound Route
tools.description: Create a new inbound email route.

tools.name: Create Segment
tools.description: Create a dynamic contact segment from a name and SQL-like rule.

tools.name: Create Subaccount
tools.description: Create a managed subaccount with optional initial email settings. An activation email can be sent; when activation email delivery is disabled, the subaccount is activated immediately. Requires an Elastic Email PRO plan.

tools.name: Create Template
tools.description: Create a new email template with its name, content, and scope.

tools.name: Create Webhook
tools.description: Create a webhook subscription for selected email events.

tools.name: Delete Campaign
tools.description: Delete one campaign by exact name. This does not cancel email already in progress.

tools.name: Delete Contact
tools.description: Delete one contact by exact email address.

tools.name: Delete Contact List
tools.description: Delete one contact list by exact name. Contacts that belonged to the list are removed from it but are not deleted.

tools.name: Delete Contacts
tools.description: Permanently delete 1-10 contacts by exact email address. This destructive action sends one targeted deletion per address and reports partial failures; it does not use rule-based bulk deletion.

tools.name: Delete Domain
tools.description: Delete one configured domain from the connected Elastic Email account.

tools.name: Delete Email Verification
tools.description: Delete one saved email verification result by exact email address.

tools.name: Delete File
tools.description: Permanently delete one stored file by its exact name.

tools.name: Delete Inbound Route
tools.description: Permanently delete one inbound email route by its public ID.

tools.name: Delete Segment
tools.description: Delete one Elastic Email dynamic contact segment by its exact name.

tools.name: Delete Suppression
tools.description: Remove one email address from Elastic Email suppression records. This can allow sending to resume, so use only with documented recipient consent.

tools.name: Delete Template
tools.description: Delete one Elastic Email template by its exact name.

tools.name: Delete Verification File
tools.description: Delete one uploaded verification file job by its VerificationID.

tools.name: Delete Webhook
tools.description: Delete one webhook subscription by its public WebhookID.

tools.name: Download File
tools.description: Download a stored Elastic Email file by its exact name.

tools.name: Download Verification File Results
tools.description: Download the ZIP result archive for a completed verification file job.

tools.name: Get Campaign
tools.description: Return one Elastic Email campaign by its exact name.

tools.name: Get Contact
tools.description: Return one Elastic Email contact by email address.

tools.name: Get Contact Export Status
tools.description: Get the current status of an asynchronous contact export job.

tools.name: Get Contact List
tools.description: Return one Elastic Email contact list by its exact name.

tools.name: Get Credential Metadata
tools.description: Get one Elastic Email API-key or SMTP credential's audit metadata without returning its secret token.

tools.name: Get Domain
tools.description: Return detailed DNS and certificate state for one Elastic Email domain.

tools.name: Get Email Job Status
tools.description: Return delivery status and optional recipient-level details for an Elastic Email transaction.

tools.name: Get Email Preview
tools.description: Return the rendered preview, attachment metadata, and delivery status for an Elastic Email message ID.

tools.name: Get Email Verification
tools.description: Return the saved Elastic Email verification result for one email address.

tools.name: Get Event Export Status
tools.description: Get the current status of an asynchronous global or channel event export. Use export_scope='global' when Start Event Export had no channel, and export_scope='channel' when it targeted a channel.

tools.name: Get File Info
tools.description: Return metadata for a stored Elastic Email file without downloading it.

tools.name: Get Inbound Route
tools.description: Return one Elastic Email inbound route by its public ID.

tools.name: Get Segment
tools.description: Return one Elastic Email dynamic contact segment by its exact name.

tools.name: Get Account Statistics
tools.description: Return aggregate Elastic Email delivery statistics for a time interval.

tools.name: Get Statistics Breakdown
tools.description: Return one Elastic Email campaign or channel delivery summary by exact name.

tools.name: Get Subaccount
tools.description: Return one managed Elastic Email subaccount by its login email. Requires an Elastic Email PRO plan.

tools.name: Get Suppression
tools.description: Return suppression details for one Elastic Email address.

tools.name: Get Template
tools.description: Return one Elastic Email template by its exact name.

tools.name: Get Verification File Results
tools.description: Return one page of detailed results and metadata for a verification file.

tools.name: Get Webhook
tools.description: Return one Elastic Email webhook subscription by its public ID.

tools.name: Import Contacts
tools.description: Start an asynchronous contact import using exactly one source: an uploaded CSV file or a provider-accessible CSV URL.

tools.name: Import Suppressions
tools.description: Upload CSV content containing bounced, complained, or unsubscribed email addresses for asynchronous suppression import.

tools.name: List Campaigns
tools.description: Find campaigns by optional name fragment and return one page.

tools.name: List Contact List Members
tools.description: Return one page of contacts in a named Elastic Email contact list.

tools.name: List Contact Lists
tools.description: Return one page of contact lists from the connected Elastic Email account.

tools.name: List Contacts
tools.description: Return one page of contacts from the connected Elastic Email account.

tools.name: List Credential Metadata
tools.description: List API-key or SMTP credential metadata without returning secret tokens.

tools.name: List Domains
tools.description: Return all sending and tracking domains configured for the account.

tools.name: List Email Verifications
tools.description: Return one page of individual email verification results.

tools.name: List Files
tools.description: Return one page of stored files and metadata.

tools.name: List Inbound Routes
tools.description: Return all inbound email routing rules in their current order.

tools.name: List Segments
tools.description: Return one page of dynamic contact segments.

tools.name: List Statistics Breakdowns
tools.description: Return one page of campaign or channel delivery summaries.

tools.name: List Subaccounts
tools.description: Return one page of managed subaccounts without credentials or passwords. Requires an Elastic Email PRO plan.

tools.name: List Suppressions
tools.description: Return one page of all suppressed addresses or only addresses suppressed for bounce, complaint, or unsubscribe reasons.

tools.name: List Templates
tools.description: Return one page of templates for the required visibility scopes.

tools.name: List Verification Files
tools.description: Return all uploaded verification file jobs and their current statuses.

tools.name: List Webhooks
tools.description: Return one page of webhook subscriptions.

tools.name: Pause Campaign
tools.description: Pause an active Elastic Email campaign by exact name, cancelling messages that are still waiting to be sent.

tools.name: Remove Contact List Members
tools.description: Remove selected contacts from a named Elastic Email contact list without deleting the contacts.

tools.name: Reorder Inbound Routes
tools.description: Set the processing order of Elastic Email inbound routing rules.

tools.name: Search Delivery Events
tools.description: Search all delivery events, one transaction's events, or one channel's events and return one page.

tools.name: Send Email
tools.description: Send an email to one or more recipients using inline content or a saved template. Submission causes external delivery and cannot be recalled.

tools.name: Send Merge File Email
tools.description: Send personalized email to recipients listed in a CSV merge-data file. Submission causes external delivery and cannot be recalled.

tools.name: Send Transactional Email
tools.description: Send one transactional message with To, CC, and BCC recipient groups. Submission causes external delivery and cannot be recalled.

tools.name: Set Default Sender Domain
tools.description: Set the domain of a verified sender email as the account default.

tools.name: Start Contact Export
tools.description: Start an asynchronous export of all contacts or contacts selected by one filter rule or a list of email addresses.

tools.name: Start Event Export
tools.description: Start an asynchronous export for all events or one channel.

tools.name: Start Verification File
tools.description: Start bulk verification for a previously uploaded CSV file. File verification is unavailable on free plans and with subaccount API keys. Usage consumes the monthly plan allowance, which resets monthly and cannot be restored.

tools.name: Trigger Campaign Automation
tools.description: Enter one contact email into an irreversible automation that may send email or execute later steps and cannot be undone.

tools.name: Update Campaign
tools.description: Update an existing active or paused campaign. Changes may initiate email delivery, and sent messages cannot be recalled.

tools.name: Update Contact
tools.description: Update the first name, last name, or custom fields for one Elastic Email contact.

tools.name: Update Contact List
tools.description: Update an Elastic Email contact list by providing at least one change: rename it with NewListName or change whether contacts may unsubscribe with AllowUnsubscribe.

tools.name: Update Domain
tools.description: Update certificate, VERP, or custom bounce settings for an Elastic Email domain.

tools.name: Update Inbound Route
tools.description: Replace an existing inbound route definition by public ID.

tools.name: Update Segment
tools.description: Replace an existing dynamic contact segment's name and rule.

tools.name: Update Subaccount Email Settings
tools.description: Replace email limits and sender settings for a managed subaccount. Requires an Elastic Email PRO plan.

tools.name: Update Template
tools.description: Replace an existing email template's name, content, and scope.

tools.name: Update Webhook
tools.description: Update a webhook URL, event notification flags, name, or enabled state.

tools.name: Upload File
tools.description: Store a base64-encoded file in the connected Elastic Email account.

tools.name: Upload Verification File
tools.description: Upload a CSV containing an email column for a later bulk verification job. This action uploads the file but does not start verification. File verification jobs are unavailable on free plans and with subaccount API keys.

tools.name: Verify Domain
tools.description: Ask Elastic Email to re-check a domain's DNS configuration.

tools.name: Verify Email
tools.description: Run verification for one email address and return its deliverability assessment. Verification is unavailable with subaccount API keys. Free plans support only this single-address verification, not file jobs. Usage consumes the monthly plan allowance, which resets monthly and cannot be restored.
